Bitcoin spot ETFs post 4th straight day of net inflows; Ethereum ETFs extend to 3 days –
Link
Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded $129M in net inflows on August 6, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $128M, marking four straight days of inflows. Ethereum ETFs added $92.1M, extending their inflow streak to three days. Cumulative BTC ETF net assets now stand at $78.8B, or 6.09% of BTC's market cap.
Matters because: sustained ETF inflows suggest institutional accumulation is still supporting spot demand despite choppy price action.
